posts.name: danmarshall14
posts.cooked:
I love those Netrunner tokens; I see them across the table from me all the time.  I personally use the Team Covenant tokens for Netrunner, which are another sexy option.  One thing I can't stand is when my Netrunner opponent uses a D20 or other dice for counters... so hard to read from across the table and very easy for them to "accidentally" turn the die to the wrong result...

I think acrylic tokens for SotM could get expensive really fast, considering some games (depending on the set up) have an outrageous number of targets and baddies with large health pools.  I could see them as a nice Add On option or an accessory in GtG's webstore though for those who don't mind paying extra to add some flashiness to their game.
